probe.name: simh
probe.cmd: cat /usr/local/share/simh-commit.txt; expect -v; printf 'show version\nexit\n' > /tmp/v.ini; vax780 /tmp/v.ini 2>&1 | head -2

build.name: assemble the .tap from the tape files (stand 512-byte records; miniroot, rootdump, usr.tar 10240) and gunzip the miniroot as a raw disk
build.cmd: python3 $HARNESS/simh_mktape.py 43bsd.tap $BODY/upstream/stand.gz:512 $BODY/upstream/miniroot.gz:10240 $BODY/upstream/rootdump.gz:10240 $BODY/upstream/usr.tar.gz:10240 && gunzip -c $BODY/upstream/miniroot.gz > miniroot.raw && sha256sum miniroot.raw 43bsd.tap | cut -c1-80

build.name: STAGE 1: console-load boot42, boot the miniroot from rq0, restore the root dump onto rq1 with the release's own xtr
build.cmd: expect $HARNESS/bsd43_install_stage1.exp miniroot.raw rq.dsk 43bsd.tap $HARNESS/boot42 > stage1.log 2>&1; grep -a STAGE1 stage1.log; grep -a -c 'Root filesystem extracted' stage1.log

build.name: STAGE 2: boot the restored root, newfs + extract /usr from tape file 4, fstab, home slice
build.cmd: expect $HARNESS/bsd43_install_stage2.exp rq.dsk 43bsd.tap $HARNESS/boot42 > stage2.log 2>&1; grep -a STAGE2 stage2.log

runs.name: STAGE 3: multi-user boot; netstat -s before and after a loopback rsh transfer of /vmunix (the fossil's TCP moving bytes through itself)
runs.cmd: expect $HARNESS/bsd43_tcp_experiment.exp rq.dsk $HARNESS/boot42 > stage3.log 2>&1; grep -a -E 'EXP:|4.3 BSD UNIX' stage3.log | head -12; grep -a -A3 'tcp:' stage3.log | head -40

notes: Follows the documented SIMH procedure (gunkies.org, Neozeed): the 780 has no tape boot ROM, so the 4.2BSD console `boot` (boot42, a 6600-byte companion, sha256 a7bacc51...) is loaded at 0 with R10=9 (uda), R11=0 and started at 2; the miniroot is attached as a raw RA81 and boots directly. Nothing in the distribution is modified. Loss/delay injection is NOT available on one guest: the loopback transfer is the 'normal transfer' pressure only; two guests over a lossy Ethernet relay is the recorded boundary (TECHNE-69b). The full install is ~45 min of emulated VAX time per run.
